sample_molecules_from_loader: sample molecular graph states from a data loader using SDE integration with configurable noise steps and discretization
sample_molecules_with_rdkit_conformers: sample molecular graph states from a data loader using RDKit-generated 3D conformers instead of SDE noise
populate_buffer_with_energy_gradients: populate a buffer of graph states and compute energy gradients and regularization forces from an energy model
populate_buffer_with_rdkit_gradients: populate a buffer of RDKit conformer graph states and compute energy gradients including torsion gradients when applicable
generate_rdkit_conformer_positions: generate multiple 3D conformer positions for a SMILES string using RDKit with chirality enforcement and duplicate handling
